mapper.insert: insert into department (parent_id, name, code, leader_id, sort, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{code}, #{leaderId}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select d.id, d.parent_id, d.name, d.code, d.leader_id, e.name as leaderName, d.sort, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time from department d left join employee e on d.leader_id = e.id
and d.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and d.status = #{status}
order by d.sort asc, d.id asc
